name: PayPal

evidence.gateway: F02: payment service provider; the merchant sells the goods and services
evidence.billing: F14: automatic subscriptions with plan, quantity and trial settings; F15: retries
evidence.links: F16: PayPal-hosted checkout with payment links and QR codes; links work without a website
evidence.crypto: C01: Pay with Crypto accepts about 100 assets for eligible US merchants; C03: paid in USD

line: Wallet and card checkout with payment links and invoices.

free.text: No monthly or setup fee in the US

cells.countries: US, UK, Germany, India and 5 other countries
cells.payout: US 1 to 3 days; UK, DE 3 to 5

fee.math: For a US seller, a PayPal wallet payment through Checkout is 3.49% plus $0.49.
For a UK seller, guest payments funded by a card are 1.2% plus £0.30.
For a German seller, this rate covers checkout, guest and other commercial payments.
Indian sellers only receive international payments, so there is no domestic card fee.
